title: Swathi Muthyam
desc: Bala Murali Krishna, a young government employee, falls in love with Bhagyalakshmi and decides to get married. Later, on his wedding day, a woman arrives with a baby and things get tense.

title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
desc: The kingdom of Rathanpur is forced to face the wrath of Bhairav Singh, who unceremoniously usurps their land. They later find respite when Gabbar Singh, a brave policeman, takes on their oppressor.

title: Dhamaka
desc: Things get complicated when Swami and Anand, two look-alike men from different backgrounds, fall in love with the same girl.

title: Love Story
desc: A Christian Zumba instructor falls for a starry-eyed upper caste Hindu girl. In their quest for happiness, they must first overcome a massive caste divide.

title: Chandramukhi
desc: When a royal family starts to witness paranormal incidents in their mansion, they get in touch with a renowned psychiatrist to trace and tackle the possessed individual.

title: SALAAR PART 1
desc: The future of a fiercely disputed nation hinges on the strained dynamics between Deva and Vardha Raja, two allies-turned-enemies.

title: Yeto Vellipoyindhi Manasu
desc: Varun and Nithya, childhood sweethearts, navigate the ups and downs of life, facing multiple separations as they grow from childhood to adulthood.

title: Lovely
desc: Kittu and Lalli are internet friends who get nervous when it is time to meet. So, Kittu sends Akash in his place while Lalli sends Lavanya, who end up falling in love with each other.

title: Saptagiri Express
desc: A happy-go-lucky actor is forced to do his father's job after his unexpected demise. However, when he realises his father was murdered, he sets out to exact vengeance.

title: Sakthi
desc: An ordinary tour guide comes to the rescue of a prominent politician's daughter after some evil Egyptians try to hunt her down in order to steal a sacred diamond.

title: Lucky Bhaskar
desc: A struggling bank teller takes a chance on a shady investment scheme with an unproven partner. Later, as his fortunes rise, so does his ego, driving him to take on increasingly reckless risks.

title: Singam
desc: Duraisingam, a righteous policeman who is not afraid to use violent means, locks horns with Vaaganam, a notorious gangster who extorts money from his victims.

title: The Raja Saab
desc: RajaSaab's search for his estranged grandfather leads him to a haunted mansion. He learns that his grandfather Kanakaraju, an exorcist, has laid a trap to lure him.

title: Pushpa
desc: Pushpa, a labourer, makes powerful enemies as he climbs the ranks of red sandalwood smuggling. However, chaos erupts when the police launch a crackdown on his illegal syndicate.
